project.title: CareLink – Healthcare Mobile Application
project.shortDescription: A Flutter mobile app for real-time doctor appointment bookings, e-pharmacy orders, and digital health records.
project.description: Developed a comprehensive healthcare mobile application enabling real-time doctor appointment booking, secure medical record management, notification systems, and medicine ordering. Reduced hospital queue management issues through real-time scheduling and e-pharmacy integration.
features: Real-time appointment booking with live queue scheduling.
Digital prescription uploads and automated medicine ordering.
Push notification alerts for appointment reminders and pill schedules.
project.challenge: Synchronizing real-time queue states across hospitals and users without causing high read/write costs on Firestore.
project.solution: Designed a optimized database schema utilizing Firestore snapshots and local caching, lowering Firestore operations by 60%.
